title: Development of a novel neodymium compound for in vivo fluorescence imaging
abstract: AbstractWe developed a novel fluorescent probe that contains the neodymium(III) complex moiety and fluorescein moiety. This probe can emit long‐lived near‐infrared luminescence derived from a Nd ion through excitation of the fluorescein moiety with visible light (λex = 488 nm, λem = 880 nm, lifetime = 2.3 µs). These results indicate the possibility of the probe as a candidate for in vivo fluorescence molecular imaging. Copyright © 2007 John Wiley & Sons, Ltd.
